cohort: 138 pregnant women at high risk of preeclampsia receiving antenatal care at Jiangnan University Hospital's obstetrics outpatient clinic.
finding: Pregnancy stress in women at high risk of preeclampsia was positively correlated with anxiety, depression, and self-management capacity, with desired mode of delivery, anxiety, and self-management capacity identified as main predictors.
mod_finding: Desired mode of delivery was found to have a significant relationship with and be a main predictor of pregnancy stress.
